run_interactive_play: run the interactive play script to manually control an articulated agent in Habitat-Sim
run_interactive_play_no_render: run the interactive play script in headless mode with the --no-render flag
run_interactive_play_save_obs: run the interactive play script with --save-obs to record a video of the agent
run_interactive_play_save_actions: run the interactive play script with --save-actions to record agent trajectories for replay
run_interactive_play_load_actions: run the interactive play script with --load-actions to replay a previously recorded trajectory
